description: Our team is dedicated to learning more about Earth Science and applying skills such as coding, arts, and data analysis to research further into our planet and encourage more people to be interested in innovation.
summary:
NASA produces incredible visualizations, but visual information isn't equally accessible to everyone.

Someone who is visually impaired, viewing the visualization on a small screen, unfamiliar with scientific graphs, and learning Earth science may have difficulty understanding a complex visualization.

Earth Jukebox provides another way to experience 
the same information.
